notes: Chess Trainer v4.0: a real Daily Puzzle — one new puzzle every day, the same for everyone, unrated, with a streak for finishing it. Puzzle Rush arrives with both chess.com modes: 3-Minute Rush and Survival — three strikes, puzzles that get harder as you solve, best scores saved. And Openings: a 250-line book of the most common openings with an Explorer that names your line as you play it, plus a Practice drill that keeps you on the book moves. Game Review's Book badge now reads the real opening book too.
